S50Z26.today_summary: 1,049.7 on the Dec future sits 0.3 points from max pain 1,050, but cumulative net dealer GEX never crosses zero across the 960-1,150 strip - it troughs at -4,309 right under the money and is still -885 at 1,150 - so dealers are positioned to amplify a move, not pin it. 15,337 contracts of open interest (+1,154 today) sit 1.08 put/call, and today's flow was put-led at 1.13 and concentrated in fresh downside insurance: +195 OI on 243 lots at the 1,000 put and +130 on 253 lots at the 960 put. ATM IV 11.18% is the lowest of the last six sessions and prices only a 7.39-point daily move, so that protection is being bought cheap at 84 DTE. The 1,100 call wall (1,254 OI, +664 over five sessions) caps the corridor 50 points above spot.
what_changed: Max pain stepped 1,060 -> 1,050 and now sits 0.3 points from spot - the third 10-point downward step since the 1,070 of 2026-09-29, with max pain walking down to spot rather than spot rising to it.
Near put wall migrated 1,040 -> 1,000 as +195 OI and 243 lots hit the 1,000 put with IV +0.60; the 1,040 strike added only +26 OI by comparison.
Put/call volume ratio flipped 0.78 -> 1.13, the first put-led session since 2026-10-01.
Net total GEX repaired -1,101 -> -885 but stayed negative; the short-gamma book is healing, it has not flipped.
S50Z26.five_day_thesis: The regime changed on 2026-10-01, not today: the Dec future gapped 1,069.1 -> 1,041.9 (-27.2) and total net GEX flipped from +374 on 2026-09-29 to -2,605, a dealer long-to-short gamma sign change that is still in force five sessions later. Open interest nearly doubled through that flip, 7,857 -> 15,337 contracts, with the heaviest builds at the 1,100 call (+664) and the 960 put (+836) - a corridor was drawn rather than a direction defended. Since then price has clawed back only 7.8 points to 1,049.7 while net GEX repaired -2,605 -> -885 and ATM IV compressed 11.48% -> 11.18%. Max pain has walked down 1,070 -> 1,060 -> 1,050 to meet spot, and the 25d skew has closed from -3.16 to -0.82 as the call-rich bulge faded. The five-day read is a short-gamma book slowly re-collateralising inside a 1,000-1,100 corridor with cheap vol, and nothing in the data says the 2026-10-01 flip has reversed.

strategies.name: Put debit spread 1030 / 1000
strategies.rationale: Buys the 1,030 put at 10.10% IV and sells the 1,000 put at 12.10% IV - 2.0 vol points of skew financing the structure - expressing the Protection-zone flow (+195 OI on 243 lots at the 1,000 put today) as defined-risk insurance instead of chasing the 960 tail where price is 8.5% away.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = net debit of about 6.7 points (1,030 put 15.3 mid - 1,000 put 8.7 mid); max payoff 23.3 points at or below 1,000; breakeven 1,023.3.
strategies.invalidation: A close above 1,070, where per-strike net GEX turns clearly positive (+59) and the corridor shifts toward the 1,100 call wall.

strategies.name: Call debit spread 1060 / 1100
strategies.rationale: Short-gamma dealers chase a break rather than fade it, so an advance through 1,060 - the first strike above spot where per-strike net GEX stops being negative (-3) before turning +59 at 1,070 - is amplified toward the 1,100 call wall, the chain's heaviest strike at 1,254 OI and +664 built in five sessions.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = net debit of about 11.4 points (1,060 call 17.6 mid - 1,100 call 6.25 mid); max payoff 28.6 points at or above 1,100; breakeven 1,071.4.
strategies.invalidation: A close below 1,030; the put side of the corridor takes over and the 1,000 wall becomes the reference level.

S50Z26.prediction: 1,030-1,070 is the base-case drift for the next five sessions: 7.39 points of 1-sigma daily move at 84 DTE is no forcing mechanism, and the 1,000 put wall and 1,100 call wall each sit roughly 50 points away. Because the book is short gamma, a break out of that band is amplified rather than faded - a close below 1,030 opens the 1,000 wall quickly, a close above 1,070 puts 1,100 in play. The bias is invalidated if cumulative net GEX turns positive around the money, which would restore mean-reverting dealer hedging and only then make 1,050 a genuine magnet.
S50Z26.risk_note: Educational analysis only - not trade advice and not an instruction to execute anything. SET50 options are cash-settled on the SET50 index with no physical delivery, so the dealer-hedging mechanics behind pinning are structurally weaker here than for share-settled single stocks: treat max pain 1,050 as a tendency, not a magnet, especially at 84 DTE. Defined risk is not risk-free - the stated max loss on each structure is real and can be lost in full. Macro and news flow can override the entire option structure.
